comment: The remote control-plane contract. tooling/remote_wire/generate.py emits rust-core/application/src/wire/contract.rs and lib/models/remote_contract.g.dart from it; the helper, the core and the client use only the generated values.

capabilities.name: refs
capabilities.doc: Branch, tag, upstream, remote configuration and checkout changes.

capabilities.name: transfer
capabilities.doc: Fetch, pull and push with the host's own Git credentials.

capabilities.name: discard
capabilities.doc: Irreversible discard of working-tree changes and removal of untracked files.

capabilities.name: history
capabilities.doc: Merge, cherry-pick, revert, rebase and restack, conflict resolution and the sequencer, and bisect.

capabilities.name: recovery
capabilities.doc: Named snapshots, restoring files, applying patches and removing a stale index lock.

capabilities.name: extensions
capabilities.doc: Worktrees, submodules, Git LFS and .gitignore entries.

capabilities.name: initialize
capabilities.doc: Creating a repository in a missing or empty folder. A write offered with the others, but without a receipt: the folder holds nothing to change.

families.name: sequencer
families.doc: Continuing, skipping or aborting an operation stopped on conflicts.

families.name: snapshot
families.doc: Creating, deleting or branching from a named snapshot.

families.name: restore
families.doc: Restoring a file from a commit.

families.name: extension
families.doc: Worktrees, submodules, Git LFS and .gitignore entries.

outcomes.name: partial
outcomes.doc: Ran and left work to finish, such as conflicts or an edit stop.

limits.name: requestsPerConnection
limits.doc: Requests a connection may have outstanding, including queued ones.

limits.name: sessionsPerConnection
limits.doc: Repository sessions one connection may hold open.

limits.name: transactionBytes
limits.doc: The largest reassembled transaction.

limits.name: chunkBytes
limits.doc: Messages above this size travel as chunk transactions.

limits.name: frameBytes
limits.doc: The largest frame payload either peer accepts.

limits.name: helloBytes
limits.doc: The largest hello or hello acknowledgement.

limits.name: jsonDepth
limits.doc: The deepest JSON nesting in a frame or transaction.

limits.name: frameCollection
limits.doc: Items per JSON array or object in one frame.

limits.name: transactionCollection
limits.doc: Items per JSON array or object in a reassembled transaction.

limits.name: pathBytes
limits.doc: Native bytes of an absolute host path.

limits.name: patchBytes
limits.doc: The largest patch a client hands over for applying, before encoding.

limits.name: conflictResultBytes
limits.doc: The largest merged file a conflict resolution saves.

limits.name: stagePaths
limits.doc: Paths one staging request names, on this computer and on a host.

limits.name: stageRows
limits.doc: Rows one partial staging or discard request names.

limits.name: stagePathBytes
limits.doc: Native bytes of one path in a staging request.

limits.name: commitSubjectBytes
limits.doc: UTF-8 bytes of a commit subject.

limits.name: commitDescriptionBytes
limits.doc: UTF-8 bytes of a commit description.

limits.name: textBytes
limits.doc: Names, targets and URLs in ref, stash and transfer requests.

limits.name: pendingOperations
limits.doc: Remote writes kept in the local record; unresolved ones are never evicted.

limits.name: summaryCharacters
limits.doc: Unicode scalar values (Dart runes, Rust chars) of a pending operation's summary.

limits.name: pageRows
limits.doc: Rows of one history, diff, blame or list page.

limits.name: branchFilterReferences
limits.doc: References one history branch filter names.

limits.name: syntaxPageRows
limits.doc: Diff rows one syntax request covers, sliced from an accepted text page.

limits.name: syntaxReplyBytes
limits.doc: Encoded bytes of one syntax reply; a longer one returns fewer rows and a continuation offset.

limits.name: syntaxSpansPerSide
limits.doc: Category spans of one side of one diff row; a row side with more stays plain.

limits.name: syntaxSourceBytes
limits.doc: Bytes of one diff source side parsed for syntax; a larger side stays plain.

limits.name: syntaxLineBytes
limits.doc: Bytes of one source line, terminator included, the syntax parser reads; it and later lines of that side stay plain.

limits.name: syntaxRetainedSourceBytes
limits.doc: Source bytes the syntax worker holds at once, queued, active and cached together.

limits.name: textSyntaxPageLines
limits.doc: Lines of a caller-held text one syntax request covers.
